card.name: Words introducing habitual or recurring actions
card.fires_on: Small words and verbs right before a habitual or repeated activity is stated, such as 'every', 'each', 'per', 'typically', 'usually', 'would' and 'comes'. The setting is general narrative text about routines.

modes.label: Frequency words
modes.description: Words that mark how often something recurs, like every, each, per, typically.
modes.example: nears Earth once<< every>> six years.

modes.label: Habitual verbs and helpers
modes.description: Verbs or helpers that set up a routine or repeated behavior.
modes.example: his mother<< would>> scold him if he spoke Tatar

card.plain: It lights up on words that set up a habit or routine, like 'every', 'usually' or 'would'.
